title: aeluropus littoralis
intro: Aeluropus littoralis, commonly known as beach grass or sand couch grass, is a species of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Aeluropus littoralis include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a valuable resource in the treatment of various skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
